themes.name: Payment and checkout failures
themes.definition: Payments, coupons or checkout steps that fail, double-charge or block an order; not pricing complaints.
themes.effort_reason: Usually one broken flow; a hotfix is possible.

themes.name: Late or slow delivery
themes.definition: Orders that arrive late, cold or after the time shown; not app speed.
themes.effort_reason: Needs courier capacity and estimate changes across operations.

themes.name: Unhelpful customer support
themes.definition: Slow, scripted or unresolved support, including refunds; not the original problem.
themes.effort_reason: Needs staffing and an escalation process.

themes.name: Sign-up and login problems
themes.definition: OTP, registration or login steps that fail; not payment verification.
themes.effort_reason: Often fixable with a backup SMS provider.

themes.name: Fees and pricing
themes.definition: Delivery fees, surge fees or prices seen as unfair; not failed payments.

themes.name: App crashes and bugs
themes.definition: The app crashes, freezes or shows errors; not slow delivery.
themes.effort_reason: Needs debugging across devices and releases.

themes.name: What customers like
themes.definition: Positive comments on variety, ease of use, speed or staff.
